title: Row erupts after Sena leader mistakenly tears paper with Bal Thackeray photo at Sonia book protest

ai.summary: Shiv Sena leaders tore pages of Sonia Gandhi's memoir to protest her remarks on VD Savarkar, but accidentally damaged a paper with Bal Thackeray's photo, causing backlash from opposition parties.

facts.claim: Shiv Sena leaders tore pages of Sonia Gandhi's memoir
facts.quote: The Shiv Sena had organised a press conference, where party leaders, including Shaina, tore copies of the book — ‘Belonging: A Journey of Love’ — to protest against Sonia’s remarks on Savarkar.

facts.claim: Shaina NC accidentally tore a paper with Bal Thackeray's photo
facts.quote: However, while doing so, a paper containing a photograph of an effigy of former Union minister Mani Shankar Aiyar being slapped by Bal Thackeray got torn by Shaina inadvertently.

facts.claim: Shaina defended the action, claiming she tore Mani Shankar Aiyar's image
facts.quote: In her defence, Shaina said she tore Mani Shankar Aiyar’s image, and not that of Bal Thackeray.
The incident drew flak from opposition Shiv Sena (UBT), Maharashtra Navnirman Sena (MNS) and Congress.
